verdict.rationale: PostHog's CDP explicitly pulls data in and 'sends the result wherever it needs to go — in realtime or on a schedule,' with pipelines built from configurable Hog functions for onward delivery, directly matching the story of streaming events to third-party destinations like webhooks/CRMs/ad platforms. Missing for 10: explicit named destination list (e.g. specific CRM/ad platform integrations) and independent hands-on confirmation of destination delivery reliability.
